blurb: This check reads the Shared Ethernet Adapter largesend attribute on a VIOS. IBM documents 0 as disabled and 1 as enabled, and says largesend should be enabled on the SEA when the physical adapter has large send enabled (https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/how-determine-if-large-send-offload-lsolargesend-and-large-receive-offload-lrolargereceive-are-enabled-sea and https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/seaproc-consuming-high-cpu-vios). The physical adapter is not visible from the SEA attribute alone, so 0 is a warning rather than a failure. No SEA is not applicable. The check never runs chdev.
